title: Consume rather than reconstruct the shared execution runtime
scope: Changes under apps/api or apps/services that compose or implement Runner, Reader, UseCaseExecutor, handler resolution, execution transactions, execution log, Outbox, or durable UseCase execution.
applies_when: A service change adds a local adapter, provider graph, token, wrapper, persistence implementation, or execution policy for a capability named in the scope.
violation: The added service code reconstructs or behavior-wraps a capability already owned by EDP or @agentic-workspace/runtime-executions instead of consuming its published runtime composition contract.
non_violation: Selecting hosted package manifests, supplying the service-owned DataSource, configuration, or external integrations, and implementing a proven service-specific capability not owned by the shared runtime are not violations.
evidence: Cite the new service-owned implementation and the specific existing EDP or @agentic-workspace/runtime-executions owner or public entrypoint that already provides the duplicated responsibility.
